scripts.dev: concurrently -n BACKEND,ADMIN,CONSUMER,PORTFOLIO,AI -c green,blue,magenta,cyan,yellow "npm run start:dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix admin" "npm run dev --prefix consumer" "npm run dev --prefix portfolio" "cd ai-service && (./.venv/bin/python run.py || .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe run.py)"
scripts.start: concurrently -n BACKEND,ADMIN,CONSUMER,PORTFOLIO,AI -c green,blue,magenta,cyan,yellow "npm run start --prefix backend" "npm run preview --prefix admin" "npm run preview --prefix consumer" "npm run start --prefix portfolio" "cd ai-service && (source .venv/bin/activate || .venv\\Scripts\\activate) && python run.py"
scripts.build: concurrently -n BACKEND,ADMIN,CONSUMER,PORTFOLIO,AI -c green,blue,magenta,cyan,yellow "npm run build --prefix backend" "npm run build --prefix admin" "npm run build --prefix consumer" "npm run build --prefix portfolio" "cd ai-service && echo 'AI Service does not need to be built'"
scripts.format: npm run format --prefix backend && npm run format --prefix admin && npm run format --prefix consumer
scripts.lint:all: npm run lint:check --prefix backend && npm run lint:check --prefix consumer && npm run lint:check --prefix admin
scripts.typecheck:all: npm run typecheck --prefix backend && npm run typecheck --prefix consumer && npm run typecheck --prefix admin
scripts.test:all: npm run test:all --prefix backend && npm test --prefix consumer && npm test --prefix admin && npm run test:guardrails
